decision: Keep the existing output executor, pacing, focus checks, generation claim, and same-connection server fence. Validate ownership once for each finite key frame and send its down/up events inside that fence. Preserve bookkeeping for every successful wire write even when a subsequent write or fence release fails. Do not cache authority or hold a server fence over waits, event drainage, external processes, or IME settlement.
